title: Ultra-Fast Language Generation via Discrete Diffusion Divergence Instruct

summary.en: DiDi-Instruct distills masked diffusion language models through integral KL minimization with discriminator-estimated density-ratio rewards. Grouped reward normalization and intermediate-state matching stabilize training, while reward-guided ancestral sampling enables efficient few-step parallel generation.
summary.zh: DiDi-Instruct 以判别器估计的密度比奖励最小化积分 KL，蒸馏 masked diffusion 语言模型。分组奖励归一化与中间状态匹配稳定训练，奖励引导祖先采样支持高效的少步并行生成。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of DiDi-Instruct: teacher and student samples are remasked at a shared noise level; a discriminator estimates density-ratio rewards to update the student. Few-step masked diffusion generation uses the student with discriminator-guided RGAS sampling.

note.en: arXiv v3, Section 4 and Table 1: the DiDi-Instruct rows use the complete configuration, including reward-guided ancestral sampling (RGAS). GenPPL is measured by GPT-2 Large; entropy is the reported sequence token entropy. RGAS uses a 131M discriminator, adding guidance and candidate-selection costs, so NFE ratios should not be interpreted as wall-clock speedups. The entry date follows the initial arXiv submission (September 29, 2025).
note.zh: 取自 arXiv v3 第 4 节及表 1：DiDi-Instruct 行使用完整配置，包含奖励引导祖先采样（RGAS）。GenPPL 由 GPT-2 Large 评测，熵为论文报告的序列 token 熵。RGAS 使用 131M 判别器，另有引导与候选选择开销，因此 NFE 比值不等于实际运行加速比。条目日期采用 arXiv 首次提交日（2025-09-29）。
